The installed thin flattened drip tape lateral is properly distinguished from the commercial package and shows a coherent monitoring context (wet strip vs. dry soil). The image correctly features neutral seedlings matching the crop data without contradiction. Minor advisory note: the secondary fine print on the carton face is stylized and not fully legible, but this does not constitute a core defect since the primary product identity is clear.
